Anatomy: every practice question

Every practice question found for the CP2 anatomy lectures: 2026 Canvas (interactive sessions, clickers, the CP II question set), the SGA drive (the 2026 C/P II TA review and the 10/20 and 10/22 TA reviews), past TA reviews, clickers and review books. A question that was basically identical in several sources is shown once, with every source listed. Similar questions sit together in a shaded box. Click an answer to check it. Under each question, Slides opens the lecture and TA-deck slides with the picture or fact behind it, never the question slide itself.
